changeSet.sql: WITH grupos AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT user_id, account_id, description, installment_total, (date_trunc('month', due_date) - make_interval(months => installment_current - 1))::date AS first_month, gen_random_uuid() AS sid FROM transactions WHERE installment_total > 1 AND installment_current IS NOT NULL AND series_id IS NULL GROUP BY user_id, account_id, description, installment_total, (date_trunc('month', due_date) - make_interval(months => installment_current - 1))::date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT installment_current) ) UPDATE transactions t SET series_id = g.sid FROM grupos g WHERE t.series_id IS NULL AND t.installment_total > 1 AND t.installment_current IS NOT NULL AND t.user_id = g.user_id AND t.account_id = g.account_id AND t.description = g.description AND t.installment_total = g.installment_total AND (date_trunc('month', t.due_date) - make_interval(months => t.installment_current - 1))::date = g.first_month;

changeSet.author: rastroos
changeSet.sql: WITH grupos AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT user_id, account_id, lower(description) AS descricao, gen_random_uuid() AS sid FROM transactions WHERE is_fixed AND installment_total IS NULL AND series_id IS NULL GROUP BY user_id, account_id, lower(description) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', due_date)) ) UPDATE transactions t SET series_id = g.sid FROM grupos g WHERE t.series_id IS NULL AND t.is_fixed AND t.installment_total IS NULL AND t.user_id = g.user_id AND t.account_id = g.account_id AND lower(t.description) = g.descricao;
